about: C5: how another tool (the deck's clients/bin/spark-model live-run guard) can tell that an eval or gate run is live, so it refuses to reload or remove models under it. Frozen by keeping the evals/ path prefix inside the sec-evals checkout. Versioning: minor = an added argv suffix or pid location; major = a renamed path, a changed pid-file format or a removed signal.
argv_rule: a process is live when one of its first argv_window arguments ends with an argv_suffix
pid_file: the first whitespace-separated token is the pid of a process that belongs to the run
repos_rule: pid_glob is matched under each checkout listed in SPARK_EVAL_REPOS (and the consumer's own checkout)

guard_liveness.rule: gate.py refuses (exit 4) when the GPU guard exits within its startup window; its output is in <gate dir>/guard.log; --no-guard is the only bypass
